blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)预测行动和未来观测,一般来自一种基于重建的表述,其中包含着吵闹的,多余的信息,可能使下游预测复杂化. 我们介绍LeWAM, 一个双向变换器, 用于前向、后向、逆向动态和政策预测, 我们看到以下好处: 1)对齐:线性探测器从LeWAM的潜伏状态读取机器人和物体状态,比普通的Le World Model(一种仅前置的JEPA世界模型)要好得多,而潜伏状态则忽略了视觉分散器以及LeWM所做的,远胜于基于重建的WAM. 2) 代理:对LEWAM的闭路评价与一个定期的流量匹配政策相匹配,该政策在相应大小的同一编码器上接受培训,同时也提供了一个世界模式。 3)规划:在与WAMs进行规划时对原始行动进行抽样,让MPC利用动态模型不准确;在政策头的噪声空间进行规划反而改善这些WAMs的闭路性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robotic control increasingly relies on predictive models to anticipate environmental dynamics. Traditional world models learn a latent space through image reconstruction, subsequently training policies conditioned on these representations [ 12 , 13 ] .
A recent evolution of this paradigm, termed world action models (WAM), explicitly couples future-state prediction with action generation to ground control directly in learned dynamics [ 42 , 19 , 37 ] . While these generative approaches successfully integrate vision and action, they predominantly rely on pixel-level reconstruction to shape their underlying representations [ 42 ] . Consequently, their latent spaces are forced to encode every visual detail a decoder might render, regardless of its relevance to the task [ 42 ] . In visually complex environments, this architectural choice inherently wastes model capacity on noisy, task-irrelevant information, complicating downstream predictive tasks [ 39 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
机器人控制越来越依赖预测模型来预测环境动态。 传统世界模式通过图像重建学习潜在的空间,随后以这些表述为条件的培训政策[12、13]。
这一范式的最近演变称为世界行动模式(WAM),明确将未来状态预测与行动生成结合起来,直接从学到的动态中进行控制[42、19、37]。 虽然这些基因方法成功地融合了愿景和行动,但它们主要依靠像素层面的重建来塑造其基本表述[42]. 因此,他们的潜伏空间被迫编码一个解码器可能制作的每一个视觉细节,而不论其与任务的相关性[42]. 在视觉复杂环境中,这种建筑选择在与任务无关的噪音信息上具有固有的废物模型能力,使下游预测任务复杂化[39,33].

blocks.en: To circumvent the limitations of reconstruction, alternative frameworks such as the joint-embedding predictive architecture model dynamics exclusively in latent space [ 20 , 3 , 5 ] . By discarding the pixel decoder entirely, these architectures inherently resist task-irrelevant appearance details [ 9 , 38 ] . Recent instantiations demonstrate stable, end-to-end training from pixels using regularization techniques that prevent representational collapse without relying on heuristics [ 24 , 4 ] . Despite these representational advantages, existing frameworks in this category typically separate the dynamics model from the policy, lacking the unified multi-modal structure found in modern WAMs [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 为规避重建的局限性,其他框架,如联合嵌入的预测性建筑模型动态,完全在潜在空间[20、3、5]。 通过完全抛弃像素解码器,这些架构内在地抵制与任务无关的外观细节[9,38]. 近期的即时分析显示,使用规范化技术,在不依赖heuristics的情况下防止代表倒闭[24,4],从像素上进行稳定,端到端的训练. 尽管有这些代表性优势,这一类的现有框架通常将动态模式与政策分开,缺乏现代WAM[24]中的统一多模式结构。

blocks.en: Bridging this gap, we propose LeWAM, a unified, reconstruction-free world action model. Building upon foundational decoder-free predictors, LeWAM introduces a bidirectional transformer capable of simultaneous forward dynamics, backward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and policy prediction [ 24 ] . The predictor is conditioned on actions, while the encoder is trained end-to-end directly from task pixels under a strict regularizer. Because the architecture eschews pixel decoders, tokenizers, and pixel-space losses, its representations are shaped entirely by the dual objectives of accurate dynamics prediction and robust action generation [ 22 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用LeWAM这一统一、无重建的世界行动模式。 LeWAM在基础解码器无预言器的基础上,引入了能同时进行前向动态,后向动态,倒向动态,以及政策预测的双向变压器[24]. 预测器以动作为条件,而编码器则在严格的正则器下从任务像素直接被训练出端到端. 由于架构eschews像素解码器,活化器,和像素-空间损耗,其表达完全由精确动态预测和强力动作生成的双重目标所塑造[22,23].

blocks.en: Integrating a generative policy within a world model naturally invites test-time intervention through planning [ 18 , 36 ] . However, executing sampling-based model predictive control over raw actions often fails in practice [ 8 ] . When optimizing over action space, the planner tends to exploit inevitable inaccuracies within the learned dynamics model, leading to plans that optimize for hallucinated futures and subsequently fail during deployment [ 1 ] . To resolve this, we shift the decision variable of the sampling-based planner from the action space to the deterministic noise space of the flow-matching policy [ 34 , 32 , 29 ] . This diffusion steering approach searches strictly within the world model’s imagination, evaluating candidates decoded at imagined states [ 15 ] . By projecting proposals onto the sampler’s typical set, the search remains constrained to actions the policy head was explicitly trained to produce.
blocks.zh: 将基因政策纳入世界模式,自然会邀请通过规划进行试验时间干预[18、36]。 然而,对原始行动实施基于抽样的模型预测控制在实践中往往失败[8]. 在优化行动空间时,规划者往往会利用所学动力模型中不可避免的不准确之处,导致计划优化以适应幻觉未来,随后在部署过程中失败[1]. 为了解决这个问题,我们将基于取样的规划者的决定变量从行动空间转移到流相匹配政策的决定性噪声空间[34、32、29]。 这种传播指导方法严格在世界模型的想象力范围内进行搜索,评价在所想象的国家解码的候选人[15]。 通过将建议投放到抽样人的典型组合中,搜索仍然受到政策负责人明确接受培训后提出的行动的制约。

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on human-generated demonstration datasets augmented with visual distractors [ 7 , 26 ] . Our investigation yields the following primary contributions: • Alignment: We demonstrate representational alignment; the latent space captures dynamic robot and object states as effectively as reconstruction-based baselines, while successfully ignoring visual distractors. • Acting: We validate robust acting capabilities; the integrated flow-matching policy matches the performance of standard behavioral cloning policies while simultaneously providing a world model for dynamics prediction. • Planning: We establish a stable planning paradigm; steering the generative process by sampling within the policy’s noise space prevents the exploitation of dynamics errors and significantly improves closed-loop performance during inference [ 31 , 35 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们对人类产生的演示数据集采取的方法,并增加视觉分光器[7、26]。 我们的调查得出了以下主要贡献: 校正:我们展示了代表式的校正;潜在的空间捕捉到动态机器人和物体状态,就像基于重建的基线一样有效,同时成功忽略了视觉分光器. 二. 支助 行动:我们验证强大的行为能力;综合流动匹配政策与标准行为克隆政策的表现相匹配,同时为动态预测提供一个世界模型。 二. 支助 规划: 我们建立了一个稳定的规划范式;通过在政策噪声空间内取样来引导基因过程,防止动态错误被利用,并在推论期间大大地改善闭路性能[31、35、17]。

blocks.en: Alignment: We demonstrate representational alignment; the latent space captures dynamic robot and object states as effectively as reconstruction-based baselines, while successfully ignoring visual distractors.
blocks.zh: 对齐 : 我们表现出了代表性的一致;潜在的空间捕捉动态机器人和物体状态与基于重建的基线一样有效,同时成功地忽略了视觉分心器。

blocks.en: Acting: We validate robust acting capabilities; the integrated flow-matching policy matches the performance of standard behavioral cloning policies while simultaneously providing a world model for dynamics prediction.
blocks.zh: 行动: 我们验证了强有力的行为能力;综合流动匹配政策与标准行为克隆政策的表现相匹配,同时为动态预测提供一个世界模型。

blocks.en: Planning: We establish a stable planning paradigm; steering the generative process by sampling within the policy’s noise space prevents the exploitation of dynamics errors and significantly improves closed-loop performance during inference [ 31 , 35 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 规划: 我们建立了一个稳定的规划范式;通过在政策噪声空间内取样来引导基因过程,防止动态错误被利用,并在推论期间大大地改善闭路性能[31、35、17]。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Table 1: World models and world action models as published: what shapes the latent and what one network does. LeWM has no policy head. Dreamer [ 13 ] ; TD-MPC2 [ 15 ] ; DINO-WM and V-JEPA 2-AC [ 40 , 2 ] ; LeWM [ 24 ] ; UWM [ 42 ] ; Cosmos Policy [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 表1:已公布的世界模型和世界行动模型:潜在因素和网络作用。 LeWM没有政策主管。 Dreamer [13]; TD-MPC2 [15]; DINO-WM和V-JEPA 2-AC [40, 2]; LeWM [24]; UWM [42]; Cosmos Policy [19].

blocks.en:
World Models such as Dreamer [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] learn a recurrent latent space primarily via reconstruction and then train policies conditioned on latents in this space.
The main shortcoming of reconstruction-based world modeling is in the capacity wasted on noisy and task-irrelevant information.
Many approaches have been proposed to address this problem.
For instance, DreamerPro and bisimulation methods [ 9 , 38 ] drop the decoder to resist task-irrelevant appearance [ 39 , 33 ] .
TD-MPC2 [ 16 , 15 ] plans by MPPI over a decoder-free latent and value.
JEPA world models [ 40 , 5 , 2 ] plan by CEM-MPC on a goal-latent distance, and LeWM [ 24 ] trains its encoder end-to-end under SIGReg [ 4 ] . LeWAM adds the action head and multi-mode skeleton to LeWM’s latent. We present a clear comparison to these methods in Table 1 . Note that the head on LeWM’s frozen latent we present in our experiments is our control, not an intrinsic part of LeWM.
blocks.zh:
诸如 " 梦想者 " [11、12、13]等世界模式主要通过重建学习一个反复出现的潜在空间,然后根据这一空间中的潜在因素来培训政策。
以重建为基础的世界模式的主要缺陷在于,它的能力被浪费在与任务无关的噪音信息上。
已经提出了许多解决这一问题的办法。
例如,DreamerPro和二相模拟方法[9,38]将解码器放下来抵制与任务无关的外观[39,33].
TD-MPC2[16,15] MPPI针对解码器无潜伏和值的计划.
JEPA世界模式 [40, 5, 2] CEM-MPC关于入球相距的计划,LEWM [24] 在SIGREG [4]下进行编码器端到端的训练. LeWAM将动作头和多模式骨架加入到LeWM的潜伏中. 我们在表1中对这些方法作了明确的比较。 请注意,我们在实验中发现的LEWM被冻结的潜伏物头是我们的控制,而不是LEWM的内在部分.

blocks.en:
One recent trend in robotics is to couple future-state prediction with action generation, grounding robot control in learned dynamics in an architecture referred to as world action models.
Dreamitate adapts a video generator to task-specific human demonstrations and tracks tools in its predictions to obtain executable trajectories [ 21 ] .
Unified World Models (UWM) makes this connection explicit through independently controlled video and action diffusion, allowing one model to serve as a policy, forward model, or inverse model [ 42 ] .
Other methods such as DreamZero exploit pretrained video priors to generalize to unseen tasks and motions [ 37 ] .
How such priors guide action varies, for instance, Cosmos Policy incorporates actions, future states, and values into the video model’s native diffusion process, enabling both control and planning [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近机器人学的一个趋势是将未来状态预测与动作生成结合起来,将机器人控制定位在一个被称为"世界行动模型"的架构中被学习到的动力学中.
Dreamitate 将一款视频生成器适应任务特定的人类演示并跟踪其预测中的工具以获得可执行的轨迹[21].
统一世界模型(UWM)通过独立控制的视频和行动传播来明确这种连接,允许一个模型作为政策,前向模型,或倒向模型[42].
DreamZero等其他方法利用预先训练的视频前传来概括到看不见的任务和动作[37].
例如,“宇宙政策”如何将行动、未来状态和价值观纳入视频模型的本土传播过程,从而能够进行控制和规划[19]。

blocks.en:
Frozen diffusion and flow-matching policies [ 7 , 22 , 23 , 6 ] offer several points of intervention for test-time control.
Guidance steers the sampling process itself [ 18 ] , whereas candidate ranking selects among policy samples using a learned value [ 27 , 19 ] or world-model rollouts [ 41 , 30 ] .
Rather than merely selecting a proposal, MPC can refine it through MPPI in action space, potentially leaving the policy’s support [ 1 , 14 ] , while Diffusion-ES alternates simulator-based scoring with re-noising and denoising [ 36 ] .
A different route is to optimize the noise that generates the action.
DSRL learns a policy over this noise through environment interaction, without a world model or planning [ 34 , 32 ] .
Golden Ticket instead searches offline with CEM, using real task-reward rollouts to find one task-specific noise vector that is reused at every step [ 29 ] . DS builds on this formulation rather than introducing a new optimizer: both its decision variable and DS-CEM’s update match Golden Ticket’s.
The distinction lies in when and where search happens, and how candidates are evaluated.
At every decision, DS searches within world-model imagination, decoding action chunks at imagined states and scoring them by goal-latent distance, without search-time environment interaction or a learned value function.
This formulation accommodates different sampling-based updates such as CEM [ 31 , 8 ] , MPPI [ 35 ] , and CMA-ES [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
冻结扩散和流量匹配政策[7、22、23、6]为试验时间控制提供了若干干预点。
指导指导采样过程本身[18],而候选人的排名则在政策样本中选择,采用学习价值[27,19]或世界模式推出[41,30]。
而不是仅仅选择一个提案,MPC可以在行动空间中通过MPPI来完善它,有可能留下政策的支持[1,14],而Difmusion-ES基于模拟器的替代得分则带有再取名和去名[36].
另一种途径是优化产生动作的噪音.
DSRL通过环境互动来学习关于这种噪音的政策,没有世界模式或规划[34,32].
Golden Ticket转而与CEM一起下线搜索,使用真正的任务奖励推开来寻找一个任务特定噪声矢量,每一步[29]都会被再用. DS基于这个配方,而不是引入新的优化器:它的决定变量和DS-CEM的更新匹配金票.
区别在于何时何地进行搜寻,如何评价候选人。
在每一个决定中,DS搜索世界模型的想象力,解码动作块以所想象的状态并用与目标相去甚远的距离来评分,没有搜索时环境的相互作用或一个已学到的值函数.
这种配方满足了不同的基于取样的更新,如CEM [31, 8],MPPI [35],以及CMA-ES [17].

blocks.en: 3 LeWAM
blocks.zh: 3 莱瓦姆

blocks.en: We use a multi-mode skeleton following UWM and Cosmos Policy. This model operates like the predictor in LeWM ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个多模式的骨架 遵循UWM和宇宙政策。 这个模型的操作方式类似于LeWM中的预测器(图1).

blocks.en: Figure 1: The four training modes on one window: the mode is set by what is masked at the transformer’s input. Nothing is decoded to pixels.
blocks.zh: 图 1:一个窗口上的四种训练模式:模式由变压器输入时所掩盖的东西来设定. 无相被解码为像素.

blocks.en: A training window contains four frames, o t − 2 : t + 1 o_{t-2:t+1} , at a frameskip of five, and the three 5-step action chunks between them, a t − 2 : t ∈ ℝ A a_{t-2:t}\in\mathbb{R}^{A} . The chunk dimension A A is five steps times the per-step action dimension ( A = 10 A=10 on PushT, 35 35 on robomimic, 70 70 on Transport), z-scored per dimension. The first three frames form the context, with latents 𝐳 t = ( z t − 2 , z t − 1 , z t ) \mathbf{z}_{t}=(z_{t-2},z_{t-1},z_{t}) ; the fourth frame is the prediction target, and the final chunk a t a_{t} is the chunk the policy must produce.
blocks.zh: 一个训练窗口包含四个框架, o t − 2 : t + 1 o_{t-2:t+1} , 以 5 为框架, 和它们之间的三个 5 步动作块, a t − 2 : t → R A a_{t-2: t}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{A} 。 块维度A是每步动作维度的5个步骤(A=10 A=10 在PushT上;35 在robomic上;70 在交通上),每个维度为z-分数. 前三帧构成上下文,其中潜出子为z t = (z t − 2, z t − 1, z t )\mathbf{zt}= (z_{t_{-2}),z_{t}t} (z_{t}t} 1}),z_{t}t}};后四帧为预测目标,最后块为t a t}t})是策略必须产生的块.

blocks.en: LeWAM masks specific inputs to serve four training modes: (i) Forward : the final frame’s latent is replaced by a mask token, all actions are clean, and the backbone regresses z t + 1 z_{t+1} via MSE against the live encoder’s output; (ii) Backward : masks the first frame’s latent, regressing it from the later frames and all actions; (iii) Inverse : keeps all frames clean and replaces the target chunk a t a_{t} with a noisy flow-matching sample whose velocity the backbone predicts, inferring the action that bridges past and future states; and (iv) Policy : masks the final frame and replaces a t a_{t} with a noisy flow-matching sample, so both losses apply and the model must deduce the action from the frames while predicting the future latent. In this mode the past action tokens ( a t − 2 : t − 1 a_{t-2:t-1} ) are replaced by a learned unknown-action token, so the policy cannot copy the demonstrator’s recent motion.
blocks.zh: LeWAM 遮掩特定输入以服务四种训练模式:(一) 前进:最终帧的潜入被口罩符所取代,所有动作都是干净的,主干通过MSE与活化编码器的输出递回了z t + 1 z_{t+1};(二) 后退:遮掩第一帧的潜入,从后帧和所有动作中递回;(三) 逆向:保持所有帧的清洁并用一个噪音的流相匹配样本来取而代之,其流相匹配的速能预测骨干,推断出桥梁过去和未来状态的行动;(四) 政策:遮掩最终帧并用潮相匹配的样本来取而代之;因此,损失和模型必须在预测未来潜入状态的同时,从帧中推断出行动。 在这种模式下,过去的动作符(t-2:t- 1 a-_{t-2:t-1})被一个学到的未知动作符所取而代之,因此政策无法复制演示人最近的动议.

blocks.en: During training, every mode is executed on every batch: the encoder processes the inputs once, the backbone runs independently for each mode, and the losses are summed. The Forward and Backward modes, alongside SIGReg [ 4 ] , impose a JEPA structure on the latent space, while the Inverse and Policy modes make the space more task-aligned.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,每个模式在每个批次上执行:编码器处理一次输入,每个模式的主干运行独立,损失被汇总. 前向模式和后向模式与SIGREG [4] 一起,将JEPA结构强加给潜在空间,而反向模式和政策模式则使空间更加符合任务。

blocks.en: Action generation employs rectified flow [ 23 ] . During training, we sample σ ∼ U ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \sigma\sim U(0,1) and construct a noisy action a σ = ( 1 − σ ) ​ a + σ ​ ϵ a_{\sigma}=(1-\sigma)a+\sigma\epsilon , training the backbone to predict the velocity target ϵ − a \epsilon-a . At test time, the action chunk is integrated from standard noise ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) using eight Euler steps. This integration forms a deterministic mapping, denoted a = g ⁡ ( ϵ , 𝐳 t ) a=g(\epsilon;\mathbf{z}_{t}) .

Notably, unlike reconstruction-based WAMs, our architecture operates without a pixel decoder, tokenizer, or any pixel- or token-space loss. As a result, the latent representations are shaped entirely by the dual objectives of dynamics prediction and action generation.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,与基于重建的WAM不同,我们的建筑运行时没有像素解码器,活化器,或者任何像素-或活化器-空格. 因此,潜在的表述完全由动态预测和动作生成的双重目标所决定.

blocks.en:
Each frame is independently encoded at a resolution of 224 224 pixels using a ViT-tiny/14.
We use the DINOv2 small architecture [ 28 ] , but train it entirely from scratch without pretrained weights.
The encoder’s [CLS] token passes through a BatchNorm MLP projector to produce a single latent vector, z t ∈ ℝ 384 z_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{384} .
This vector serves as the model’s sole representation: it is read by the probes, compared by the planner, and regressed by the dynamics model.
Similar to LeWM, this latent is taken directly from the live encoder output, without relying on an exponential moving average (EMA) target network or a stop-gradient operation.
To prevent representation collapse, we apply SIGReg [ 4 ] , which regularizes the model by pushing the batch of latents toward an isotropic Gaussian distribution.
blocks.zh:
每个帧独立地被用一个VIT-tiny/14的分辨率224 224像素编码.
我们使用DINOv2小建筑[28],但完全从零开始训练,没有预先训练的重量.
编码器的 [CLS] 符号通过一个 BatchNorm MLP 投影器, 生成一个单一的潜在向量, z t ∈ R 384 zt\in\mathb{ R}^{384} 。
这种向量是模型的唯一代表:它由探测器读取,由规划者作比较,由动态模型倒置.
与LEWM类似,这种潜伏直接取自活编码器输出,而不依赖于指数移动平均(EMA)目标网络或停止升级操作.
为了防止代表性崩溃,我们应用了SIGREG [4],它通过将一大批潜伏物推向异地高斯分布来规范模型.

blocks.en: A bidirectional transformer of depth 8, width 512 and 16 heads reads the three frame latents and three action tokens with modality, frame and σ \sigma embeddings, and serves four modes by masking. Figure 2 shows the LeWAM architecture of Section 3 : a shared ViT-tiny encoder with SIGReg on its single latent per frame, and one bidirectional transformer that serves the four training modes of Figure 1 by masking.

blocks.en: 4.2 Motivation: Failure of Action-Space MPC with LeWM

blocks.en: While action-space sampling-based MPC has been shown to work with LeWM, it fails on the smaller human-sourced datasets studied here (see Figure 5 ). We hypothesize that the dynamics model is imperfect with less data, and compounds errors during planning rollouts. Gaussian action-sampling MPC on such a model optimizes for hallucinated futures, and the planned actions fail during deployment.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Tasks and data.
blocks.zh: 5.1 任务和数据。

blocks.en: PushT [ 10 , 7 ] : a circular agent pushes a T-shaped block to a fixed target pose; actions are absolute target positions at 10 Hz in chunks of five. We use the 206 human demonstrations of Chi et al. [7] and paint two distractors that are independent of the actions: a dot on a Lissajous curve and a bar sliding along the top edge. robomimic [ 25 ] : Lift, Can, Square, ToolHang and Transport, using the benchmark’s 200 proficient-human demonstrations replayed in robosuite. We add two grey distractor boxes, larger than the task objects, that wobble in every scene without affecting the dynamics.
blocks.zh: PushT [10, 7]: 循环剂将一个T形块推向固定目标;动作是绝对目标位置为5个块的10赫兹. 我们使用Chi等人的206人示威. [7],并画出两个独立于动作的分心器:利萨霍斯曲线上的一个点和沿着上边缘滑动的条. robomic [25] : Flift, Can, Square, ToolHang and Transport, 使用基准的200个熟练-人类示威在robosoite重现. 我们增加两个灰色的分心箱, 大于任务对象, 在每个场景中摇摆而不影响动态。

blocks.en: Every model is trained on these frames alone ( Figure 3 ): pixels in, actions out, with no proprioception or state. Training runs for 300 epochs and five seeds on a 90% split of the data; evaluation uses the remaining 10% and runs in the same simulator with distractors present.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都只对这些框架进行培训(图3):像素在,动作出,没有自发或状态. 培训为300个纪元和5个种子提供90%的数据;评价使用其余的10%,并在同一模拟器中运行,有分心器。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines.

We train three baselines and a reference. All are our reimplementations that retain their authors’ original architectures but share one training protocol (pixels only, 300 epochs, five seeds, identical optimization and learning-rate schedules), sized to roughly match LeWAM’s 41.0M trainable parameters. Dreamer [ 12 ] : an RSSM trained by image reconstruction with an MLP action head. LeWM [ 24 ] : has no action head, so we freeze it and train LeWAM’s rectified-flow head on its latents with the same loss and schedule as LeWAM. RecWAM : the Cosmos Policy architecture [ 19 ] at LeWAM’s scale, a flow-matching transformer over the tokens of a VAE pretrained on each dataset’s frames, denoising the next frame and action chunk jointly. Flow-matching policy : LeWAM’s encoder and head trained through the policy loss only, so no world model.
blocks.zh: 我们训练三个基线和一个参考。 所有都是我们重新实施的,它们保留了作者的原始架构,但共享一个训练协议(像素,300个世纪,5个种子,相同的优化和学习率时间表),大小大致符合LeWAM的41.0M可训练参数。 Dreamer [12]:通过图像重建训练的RSSM,并有MLP动作头. LeWM [24]:没有动作头,所以我们冻结了它,并用与LeWAM相同的损失和时间表,训练LeWAM的正流头在它的潜伏上. RecWAM:在LeWAM的尺度下,宇宙政策架构,一个流相比变压器,在每套数据集的相框上预加了VAE的标志,同时去除下个相框和动作块. 流动匹配政策: LeWAM的编码器和头部只经过政策损失的训练,所以没有世界模式。

blocks.en: 5.3 Latent Space analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 后期空间分析

blocks.en: For each model and task we fit a ridge regression from the latent to agent, object, gripper and distractor state, with cross-validation to remove any decoder confounds, and evaluate it on a hold-out set. We track MSE, Pearson’s r r and explained variance R 2 R^{2} , both on the state variables that matter for the task and on those of the task-irrelevant distractors. Table 2 shows that, on average, LeWAM encodes task-relevant state better than LeWM and even the reconstruction-based models, and ignores distractors as well as LeWM.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个模型和任务,我们搭配了从潜入物到物剂,物体,抓取物和分心物状态的脊回,通过交叉验证来去除任何解码器的错觉,并在被搁置的集合中加以评价. 我们追踪MSE、Pearson的r 和解释R 2 R^{2}的相差, 表2显示,平均来说,LeWAM编码与任务相关的状态比LeWM甚至基于重建的模型更好,并忽略了分心者以及LeWM.

blocks.en: Table 2: Linear probe metrics across all tasks, 5 seeds (Negative R 2 R^{2} clipped to 0).
blocks.zh: 表2:覆盖所有任务的线性探测仪,5个种子(Negative R 2 R^{2}被剪接到0个).

blocks.en:
To visually verify the quality of the latent space and the world model, we train a plain feed-forward convolutional decoder on a frozen pre trained LeWAM model.
Note that gradients from the decoder do not change the latent space as this is done after LeWAM training.
We show the rollouts from PushT and Robomimic Lift in Figure 4 tasks.
For PushT we can see that the location of T block is consistently identified, but the rotation is blurry.
This seems to be true for both the input context frames as well as the imagined frames.
A point to note here is that the distractors are almost completely missing in the imagined rollouts.
This further strengthens the linear probe results.
In the Lift task, we see similar results, where the distractor blocks are either missing or wrongly predicted by the decoder.
We believe the presence of the distractor block (but still in the wrong location) is an artifact of the decoder hallucinating.
blocks.zh:
为了直观地验证潜在的空间和世界模型的质量,我们在一个被冻结的预训练的LeWAM模型上训练出一款平坦的饲料前导分解器.
请注意,解码器的梯度不会改变潜在的空间,因为这是在LeWAM训练后进行的.
我们在图4中展示了PushT和Robomimic Left的推出。
为了推 T我们可以看到,T块的位置被一致地识别出来,但旋转模糊.
这似乎既适用于输入上下文框架,也适用于想象中的框架。
这里需要指出的是,在想象的推出中,分散注意力者几乎完全缺失.
这进一步加强了线性探测结果.
在"升起"任务中,我们看到类似的结果,其中分心器块要么缺失,要么被解码器错误地预测出.
我们认为分心器块的存在(但仍位于错误的位置)是解码器幻觉的出品.

The first 3 frames are context frames that is passed as input to the model. The 5 frames that follow are imagined frames by rolling out the LeWAM’s forward mode using ground truth actions.

blocks.en: 5.4 Closed-loop evaluation.
blocks.zh: 5.4 闭路评价。

blocks.en: We evaluate each model’s policy for 250 rollouts (5 training × \times 50 evaluation seeds) on all six tasks with visual distractors. For each world model we also run MPC in its latent space, sampling both in action space (CEM, MPPI, CMA-ES) and in the policy’s noise space (DS-CEM, DS-MPPI, DS-CMA-ES); the goal is the latent 25 steps after the demonstration frame nearest the current latent. A BC-only flow-matching policy serves as reference.
blocks.zh: 我们评价每个模式的政策, 对于每个世界模型,我们也在其潜在空间运行MPC, 在动作空间(CEM、MPPI、CMA-ES)和政策噪声空间(DS-CEM、DS-MPPI、DS-CMA-ES)中进行采样; 目标是在演示框架最接近当前潜在区域之后的25个潜在步骤。 仅以业连流程匹配政策作为参考。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Closed-loop success of all models and planners, over 5 training seeds × \times 50 evaluation seeds (250 rollouts).
blocks.zh: 图5:所有模式和规划者都取得了封闭式成功,超过5个培训种子×=50个评价种子(250个推广)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that RecWAM’s policy is slightly below the reference, which we believe reflects capacity spent on pixel reconstruction, while Dreamer and LeWM + diffusion head perform very poorly. LeWAM’s policy maintains the reference’s performance. Sampling in noise space gives both LeWAM and RecWAM a performance gain at inference time, whereas action-space MPC collapses every model to 3–8% success, confirming that the planner exploits dynamics errors ( Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 图5显示RECWAM的政策略低于参考, 我们认为这反映了在像素重建上花费的能力, 而Dreamer和LeWM+扩散头的表现非常差. LeWAM的政策保持了参考的绩效. 在噪声空间中取样可以让LeWAM和RecWAM在推断时间获得性能收益,而动作空间MPC则将每个模型崩溃到3-8%的成功率,从而证实规划者利用了动态错误(第4.2节).

To analyze the importance of each mode in LeWAM, we perform an ablation by switching off each mode during training and evaluate it on three robomimic tasks (Lift, Can and Square).
From Table 3 , we can see that all modes add value to both forming an informative latent space as well as closed-loop performance on average over tasks.
State information in the latent space, policy rollout and planning all seem to improve with all four modes.
Forward and backward consistently help; inverse is neutral on Square.

潜在空间中的国家信息、政策推出和规划似乎都以所有四种模式得到改善。
前向和后向始终帮助;反向在平方是中性的.

We also ablate the projection step of Section 4.4 , keeping the budget and goals of Section 4.3 . Removing it lowers DS-CEM success on all three tasks ( Table 4 ), by about 5 points on Lift, 12 on Square and 56 on Can.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
This paper presents LeWAM, a decoder-free JEPA-based world action model.
We show that LeWAM’s latent space is more informative than LeWM’s, and is void of the visual features that do not affect task dynamics.
This property allows LeWAM to better model policy actions.
Finally, we show that by sampling in diffusion noise space (an inference-only procedure), we can effectively plan with LeWAM and improve average closed-loop performance across tasks.
We believe the two logical next steps are: (1) applying LeWAM to real-world data, which contains an abundance of dynamically inert features; and (2) improving planning algorithms with LeWAM, as these are slow and also require a notion of a goal at inference time.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了LeWAM,这是一个基于JEPA的解码器免费世界行动模型.
LeWAM的潜在空间比LeWM的空间更丰富,
这一财产使LeWAM能够更好地示范政策行动。
最后,我们表明,通过在扩散噪声空间取样(一种仅通过推论的程序),我们可以有效地与LEWAM进行规划,并改进跨任务的平均闭路性能。
我们认为,接下来的两个逻辑步骤是:(1) 将LeWAM应用于真实世界的数据,其中包含丰富的动态惰性特征;(2) 改进与LeWAM的规划算法,因为这些算法很慢,在推论时也需要一个目标的概念.

Lift, Can and Square are rendered at 84 84 px from the agent-view camera; ToolHang at 168 168 px from the benchmark’s side camera, which keeps the tool, its frame and the boxes in view; and Transport at 256 256 px as the two shoulder cameras, one per arm, stacked into a single frame so that the hand-over between the arms is visible. All frames are resized once to 224 224 px. Evaluation uses 50 seeded simulator resets per seed, with the boxes moving.
blocks.zh: PushT在512个512个px表上以96个96个px得到,并被调整为编码器224个224个px. Flift, Can and Square从代理视相机中以84 84 px提供; ToolHang从基准的侧相机中以168 168 px提供,使工具、其框和箱保持视线;以及 Transport 以256 256 px作为两台肩相机,每只手臂一个,叠成一帧,以便两臂之间的交接可见. 所有帧被一次调整为224 224 px. 评估使用每个种子的50个种子模拟器重置,并随箱移动.

blocks.en: Appendix C Model sizes
blocks.zh: 附录C 模型大小

blocks.en: All four models are matched in trainable parameters. LeWAM has 41.0M: a ViT-tiny/14 encoder (width 192, depth 12, 3 heads × \times 64) with its projector, and a bidirectional transformer of width 512, depth 8, 16 heads × \times 64 and MLP 2048. LeWM’s autoregressive predictor is widened from the released configuration (width 192, depth 6; 18.0M in all) to width 512, 16 heads × \times 64, MLP 2048 at depth 6, for 42.2M in all. RecWAM’s flow transformer is widened and deepened to width 512, depth 10, 16 heads × \times 64, MLP 2048, for 42.6M trainable parameters, plus a 3.9M VAE tokenizer that is pretrained per dataset and frozen. Dreamer’s RSSM is trained by image reconstruction at 96 px with the balanced KL, and is enlarged from the standard configuration (13.6M) by widening every component: deterministic state 512 to 1536, stochastic state 32 to 64, GRU and MLP hidden 512 to 1280, image embedding 1024 to 1280, for 43.4M.
blocks.zh: 所有四种型号都配有可训练参数. LeWAM有41.0M:一个ViT-tiny/14编码器(宽192,深度12,3个头×\times 64)及其投影仪,并有宽度512,深度8,16个头×\times 64和MLP 2048的双向变速器. LeWM的自递回预测器从所释放的配置(宽192,深度6;共计18.0M)被拓宽到宽512,16个头×\times 64,MLP 2048 在深度6,共计42.2M. RecWAM的出行变压器被加宽并深化到宽度512,深度10,16个头×\times 64,MLP 2048,用于42.6M可列车参数,外加一个每个数据集和被冷冻的3.9M VAE标致器. Dreamer的RSSM通过图像重建在96px与平衡的KL进行训练,并且从标准配置(13.6M)被扩展出每个组件:确定状态512到1536,结构状态32到64,GRU和MLP隐藏512到1280,图像嵌入1024到1280,用于43.4M.

blocks.en: Appendix D Protocol and training hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 附录D 议定书和培训超参数

blocks.en: Ridge regression from the latent to agent location, block location, block angle and the two distractor positions on PushT, and to the end-effector position, the gripper opening, the task object’s position and the two boxes on robomimic; R 2 = 1 − MSE / Var R^{2}=1-\mathrm{MSE}/\mathrm{Var} on held-out episodes, with five-fold cross-validation over the penalty and a shuffled-target control, the same regression fit to permuted targets, which sits at or below zero for every model and task.
blocks.zh: R 2 = 1 - MSE / Var R^{2}=1-\mathrm{MSE}/\mathrm{Var}在停放事件上从潜入代理位置、区块位置、区块角度和PushT上的两个分散器位置返回到终端效应位置、抓取器打开位置、任务对象位置和robomic上的两个框; R 2 = 1 - MSE / Var R^{2}=% 1-\mathrm{MSE}/\mathrm{Var},对罚则进行五倍的交叉验证并进行洗牌目标控制,同样的回归适合穿透目标,每个模型和任务都坐落在零下.

blocks.en:
Every planner uses the same budget, 64 samples, 3 iterations and 8 elites: the action-space planners, CEM, MPPI and CMA-ES, over action sequences of 5 chunks.
For Dreamer, whose MLP head is deterministic, the 64 ranked candidates are the head’s chunk plus 63 Gaussian perturbations of it with standard deviation 0.2 in z-scored action units, scored by Dreamer’s own planning cost, the pixel error of the decoded rollout to the goal frame; the head’s chunk is always a candidate, so ranking cannot fall below the policy, and no DS variant exists for it, since there is no noise-to-action map to search over.
Goals are retrieved in each model’s own latent space, by encoding the observation 25 steps ahead of the closest latent from a given demonstration.
The robomimic horizons are 100 steps on Lift, 400 on Can and Square, and 700 on ToolHang and Transport; LeWAM uses the configuration of Table 5 on every robomimic task.
blocks.zh:
每个规划师使用相同的预算,64个样本,3个迭代和8个精英:行动空间规划师,CEM,MPPI和CMA-ES,超过5个块的行动序列.
对Dreamer来说, 他的MLP头是决定性的, 排名为64位的候选人是头的块加上63位高斯人对它的扰动,
目标在每一个模型自己的潜在空间中取回,方法是将观测数据编码为25个步骤,比特定演示中最接近的潜在步骤提前。
robomic地平线为起重道上100步,Can和Square道上400步,TolleHang和Transport道上700步;LeWAM在每个robomic任务上采用表5的配置.
